attempts.detail: GA: Georgia cannot be collected unattended. The Secretary of State's only machine-readable absentee/advance-voting file is gated by reCAPTCHA Enterprise on https://mvp.sos.ga.gov/s/voter-absentee-files: the presign action refuses every request without a live browser-minted token, the S3 bucket behind it is private, and no unprotected sibling or alternative statewide feed exists (see docs/georgia-source.md for what was checked). Export GA_SOS_RECAPTCHA_TOKEN from a browser step to collect Georgia by hand; otherwise this must fall through to the aggregator, which does carry Georgia.
attempts.name: ga-sos
